description.text: What we want you to do As a Data Engineer for MTGIQ you will be a key resource in our mission to continue building a group wide data warehouse and analytics solution for the purpose of increasing customer and content insights, supporting data driven business decisions throughout all MTG's business areas. We want you to develop multiple integrations between our plethora of source systems, build solid solutions and structures for fetching both batch and real-time data, as well as transform said data to feed into our Business Intelligence applications. As part of the job, you will support the continuous data and information modelling activities in order to secure a reliable data structure as well as efficient development and maintenance over time. Your experience and knowledge will also be critical in our work to improve the engineering process, including code principles, architecture, documentation, testing etc. What we can offer you We offer you the opportunity to work with large amounts of data, transforming it to understandable information that helps our business areas improve their understanding of product usage, customer behaviour and more. You will develop on the Hadoop stack, preferable using Python and Java in connection with Spark. Our work pace is high and we believe that you will be challenged by all the different projects inside the team. In addition you will be part of a team responsible for accelerating data driven decision-making in the entire group. Everything we do, and how we do it is not yet carved in stone, meaning that you will have the opportunity to influence in many aspects. What we ask of you We're looking for someone with strong background in data, data warehousing and data architecture, interested in fetching everything from traditional, relational data to semi- or unstructured data in large amounts. You have probably had several roles in traditional data warehouse development projects but realised that the future lies within the possibility to handle massive amounts of data with new technology stacks like Hadoop. You have probably worked a few years developing on Hadoop and Spark, preferably with Python and Java. Since we run our solutions in the cloud, experience in Amazon AWS, especially EC2, S3 and EMR are also desired but not mandatory. MTGIQ is the central initiative supporting our commercial departments with data and solutions for business intelligence and analytics. We are running several projects in parallel, aiming at accelerating data driven decision making across all our business areas, and support the changes this means to the business on all levels. MTG (Modern Times Group MTG AB (publ.)) is a leading international digital entertainment group and we are shaping the future of entertainment by connecting consumers with the content that they love in as many ways as possible. Our brands span TV, radio and next generation entertainment experiences in esports, digital video networks and online gaming. Born in Sweden, our shares are listed on Nasdaq Stockholm ('MTGA' and 'MTGB').

We are looking for data engineers that will build data-driven solutions to bring music and digital media experiences to our 100 million active users either by working directly on product features, analysing our usage data or by improving the quality of our data tools and large-scale data infrastructure. Above all, your work will impact the way the world experiences music. All is powered by 15000 data jobs, running on one of Europe's largest Hadoop clusters (1600+ nodes) and crunching 50 petabytes of data. What you'll do - Continuously design, develop, and test data-driven solutions - Work with state-of-the-art data processing frameworks and technologies - Improve data quality through testing, tooling and continuously evaluating performance - Work closely with software engineers, machine learning experts, and decision-makers to build solutions and gain novel insights - Work in cross-functional agile teams to regularly experiment, iterate, and deliver on new product objectives with an end-to-end responsibility for your squad's mission - Work from our office in Stockholm (Sweden) Who you are - You have a passion for data and for transforming numbers into key business insights - You have experience with (or have an interest in) data processing frameworks like Crunch, Scalding, Storm or Spark - You care about agile software processes, data-driven development, reliability, and responsible experimentation - You are passionate about creating clean code and have a strong foundation in coding and building data pipelines We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. We strongly believe that diversity of experience, perspectives, and background will lead to a better environment for our employees and a better product for our users and our creators. This is something we value deeply and we encourage everyone to come be a part of changing the way the world listens to music Kompetens: Programmering, Krav; Språk: Engelska, Krav; Yrkeserfarenhet: Dataingenjör, 2-4 års erfarenhet, Meriterande;

description.text: As a Data Engineer here at Klarna, you'll get to research and implement new credit risk variables into our credit risk systems. More specifically, you?ll get to; Identify, implement and test new credit variables in our Hadoop based credit risk decisioning systems that perform credit scoring in real time. Your primary focus will be on structuring a multitude of existing data sources to make them available to our risk variable library. Ensure new variables fit our global requirements and align with our wider business goals. Gain a deep understanding of the implications of different data sources used at Klarna. Analyse the performance of different data pipes and aggregations. Set up a monitoring framework that different teams can use to keep control over their datasets. You'll need to have; An expert knowledge of using SQL to query and restructure data within large data stores; we mainly use Hive to query our Hadoop cluster. An interest in big data and data innovations. An academic background in Information Science, Computer Science or a mathematical discipline. Benefits The opportunity to learn about how we effectively make near real time credit risk decisions for millions of users worldwide. Grow your knowledge in the use of the Hadoop ecosystem to store, structure and process large data sets. Competitive salary. Extensive learning and development opportunities. 30 days annual leave with the ability to take 4 weeks consecutive leave. Get your choice of Macbook or PC and iPhone or Android. A learning and development centric environment with an emphasis on knowledge sharing, training and regularly sponsored tech talks. Generous occupational pension and insurance plans. International English speaking office in central Stockholm with over 38 nationalities - https://insideklarna.com/2016/06/16/the-klarna-house/ Subsidised gym membership. Interested in finding out more? Send over your CV in English and let's arrange a chat.

Ticket är idag den största privatresebyråkedjan i Norden med sajterna Ticket, Airngo, över 400 medarbetare och sina 70 butiker i Sverige och Norge. Vi har stark tillväxt och gör det med marknadsledande lönsamhet. Vi bygger och driftar själva vår e-handelsplatform med alltifrån utmanande backendfrågor inom skalning till att sälja rätt produkter till rätt person på ett för kunden enkelt sätt. Ticket sitter i toppmoderna lokaler i Sickla, några minuter från Slussen. Här jobbar ca 80 personer med allt från sälj, utveckling, marknadsföring till ekonomi och personal. Du kommer att jobba i en organisation med korta beslutsvägar och där det går snabbt från beslut till handling. Våra agila team är självgående och utvecklingsgruppen gör själva teknikval och andra viktiga beslut. Dina kollegor här är riktigt skarpa, hjälpsamma, drivna och många har jobbat 10-15 år. Vår Data Engineer kommer att jobba som utvecklare nära försäljningsavdelningen och ekonomi för att hitta rätt siffror för att analysera verksamheten till att bli ännu mer datadriven. Vi jobbar idag med Qlikview, datavaruhus, micro services, Elasticsearch, Docker, molnet, Java och CI. Allteftersom våra analysbehov växer så har du utmärkta möjligheter att växa med stacken och lära dig nytt. Var med och utforma vår miljö med data pipelines, R, Spark, Storm, Dataproc, Datalab, Redshift osv. All utveckling sker agilt och krossfunktionellt och beroende på projekt väljer vi mellan Scrum och Kanban. Även vår produktutveckling är agil - vi gillar att lansera funktioner tidigt och se vad kunderna gör. För att trivas som Data Engineer hos oss har du jobbat något år och vill gärna diskutera både tekniska lösningar och vilken data som är intressant att få ut och varför. Som person tar du enkelt till dig ny teknik och har ett eget intresse av att lära dig nytt. Du finner egenvärde i att kod är lättläst, testbar och buggfri. Till vardags kommer du bygga lösningar för att utöka mängden analyserbar information i våra verktyg tillsammans med andra utvecklare och våra analytiker. Du får vara med från behov till färdiga verktyg. Hjälp oss att ställa rätt frågor bland våra stora datamängder. Varje år lägger vi själva upp vilka aktiviteter vi prioriterar utifrån avdelningens egen vision. Under sommaren sen kör vi helt och hållet systemförbättringar som utvecklarna vill genomföra. Självklart måste vi som utvecklare också bli bättre så vi gör individuella planer för utbildning som kurser och konferenser förutom att ha gemensamma kodaktiviterer, resor, after works och annat kul.Givetvis har du sex veckors semester, flex så vardagen fungerar, full tjänstepension enligt ITP och trevliga reseförmåner. Mer om Ticket och ansök på http://www.ticket.se/jobb.html - vi behandlar ansökningar löpande. Ansök med CV eller LinkedIn.

Lifesum is a Stockholm-based tech startup with a vision to make it simple for people everywhere to lead healthy lifestyles. Our app combines technology and applied psychology with personal preferences to help people form habits that build towards healthier, happier lives. We're now looking for an experienced engineer with a strong interest in data analysis and infrastructure. As part of a small analytics team, you will help us to develop and maintain a strong technical base for answering questions with our data, from capturing events to building the data pipelines needed to analyse them. As our base matures, you will help our cross-functional product teams to ask the right questions, and to form and test hypotheses about our users. You are comfortable working rapidly with small datasets, but have the engineering skills to capture and refine large datasets. Tech-wise, we have a mobile-first product spanning iOS and Android, with server code written in Python. You will be exposed to cloud hosting (Amazon), SQL and no-SQL databases (MySQL, Redis, MongoDB), search solutions (Sphinx, ElasticSearch), data warehousing and BI (Omniata, Redshift), and microservices. Depending on your expertise, need and interest, there may be scope to grow this stack. This role is a good fit for an analytical and creative engineer or ex-researcher who thrives by working closely with others. We follow the motto "team work is better work". You want to grow and learn from others, and you also want to teach and help others grow. Responsibilities Take initiative in growing our understanding of the data we have as well as using it for new features as well as business insights Taking features from the idea stage to scalable production deployments Take part in improving the platform as a whole as the company grows Enable others to be more productive when working with data Requirements You are a doer and love to see what you built in production Passion and curiosity. You love distributed systems and solving our users' problems in a smart and scalable way A strong interest in data analysis and the infrastructure for it 5+ years software development experience Masters or PhD in a scientific discipline a plus You have worked in a team of developers and know the benefits of tests, continuous integration, logging and monitoring You have experience working in Python or a similar language You have previously built and maintained data pipelines You are a team worker with excellent communication skills Fluent (written and verbal) in English It's a plus if you have a passion for health and fitness As a person you continuously challenge yourself to find new ways of developing our platform. You have a burning desire to improve and you are not afraid to roll up your sleeves and get the work done.

Etraveli is now recruiting an experienced Data Engineer. The mission is to tie the departments together, and data is the rope. Etraveli is the leading flight centric online travel agent (OTA) in the Nordic region. The core business is airline tickets and travel related services, targeted towards high volumes of price sensitive consumers. Expertise in travel e-commerce and economies of scale together with an impressive proprietary IT platform enables Etraveli to apply a scalable and profitable business model. The core of the technical platform, the Internet Booking Engine (IBE), serves price comparison sites and customers with attractive travel options retrieved from centralised flight market places. Every minute, four million travel options are automatically assessed, compiled, and re-priced. Intense data analysis, price optimisation, and configuration automation is crucial in order to keep our margins high. Bisam (Business Intelligence Statistical Analysis and Modelling) is our data science team. The Bisam initiative is still in the formation phase, but it is already an integral part of the company's operation and vision and has shown rewarding. The team is split across the offices in Uppsala and Göteborg and acts cross functional and cross department. The engaged roles span developers, analysts, database managers, and information engineers. You will sort under the Development department, which is managed from Göteborg. The work as Data Engineer will centre around data integration and software configuration description for our operational data store. In accordance with Etraveli's data strategy we are in the process of introducing a massive parallel processing database in the information chain, building on the Cloudera Hadoop Distribution. You will be responsible for data description, integration of data streams and reference tables from the IBE, data normalisation and more. But it does not stop there. Etraveli's data stock with internal and external data is impressive and still rapidly growing in dimensions and volume. Yourself, you are a computer scientist, mathematician, statistician, or similar by education with proved experience from data transformation in the Hadoop environment. You have a solid technical background in software development and configuration. Your role will be as a developer in the Development department, but you will work in close cooperation with database and system administrators in Operations. You have strong communication skills. Our team is small but strong, so you appreciate and are prepared to roll up your sleeves and dig in where there is need, whether that is internally, attending some random system configuration, or externally with requirement management or information engineering. All in all, times will be great. You'll find yourself in a highly creative environment, surrounded by awesome coworkers, challenging problems, and demanding, rewarding customers. Responsibilities Data description, normalisation, and transformation Data acquisition Integration of data streams and other data sources into the operational data store Configuration of data management software including streaming and scheduling software Outreach review of technologies for data engineering Integration of such technologies into existing environment Information engineering Required qualifications University master degree in computer science, mathematics or comparable Demonstrated database experience, SQL and NoSQL Demonstrated experience from data definition and description Demonstrated programming experience Meriting experiences Distributed storage and data layer tools (Hadoop, Hive, Kite) Cluster computing and massive parallel processing (Spark, SQL, Cloudera Impala, HP Vertica) Data stream transfer and aggregation technologies (Sqoop, Flume, Kafka) Scheduling and data flow management (Oozie, Airflow) System configuration (Windows server, GNU/Linux tool sets) Scientific programming languages and frameworks (R, NumPy derivatives , Matlab) Agile software development processes (Scrum) Location. Sweden. Both Göteborg and Uppsala are possible. Travels. Regular national commutes. Keywords. MPP, SQL, Impala, Spark, Flume, Sqoop, Hadoop, OLAP

Engineers within Analytics enable Klarna to make real-time credit risk and fraud decisions using behavioural data. A few of the things that set us apart: We work in small highly collaborative agile teams that typically includes Data Scientists, Software Engineers, Analysts and a Product Manager. You and your team will have a clear mission and ownership of an important outcome that supports Klarna and our customers. At Klarna we optimise for quality, flow, fast feedback and time to market. To do this we focus on end-to-end ownership, continuous improvement, testing, monitoring and experimentation. We aim for teams that are inclusive, helpful, and have a strong sense of ownership for the things they build. Technologies you would be working with: Java, Scala, Hadoop, Hive, PostgreSQL, Docker, Kafka, Kafka streams and AWS. What we offer: - Be yourself in informal, low-ego and open working environment where you can truly make a difference and enjoy working with positive, passionate and collaborative people - An environment that supports learning and is committed to your professional and personal development - Competitive salary. - Generous pension and insurance plans. - 30 days annual leave with the ability to take 4 weeks consecutive leave every year. - Parental leave of up to 100% of your salary for 180 days (in Sweden you have 480 days of paid parental leave per child) - International relocation support for you and your family. - English speaking international working environment (42 nationalities) in central Stockholm. - Fitness and wellbeing allowance. What we look for in you? We're looking for engineers that share our passion for building great products using solid engineering practises. We are looking for positive and passionate people who will put teamwork and collaboration above all else. You will need to be comfortable in a rapidly changing environment and able to navigate ambiguity and a high rate of change. The ideal person: Technical background in one or more languages (Java, Scala, Erlang, Python) and one of the following: - Hadoop, Spark - Key-value stores, relational databases - Kafka, Kafka Streams, Spark Streaming, Flink - Have successfully applied and are enthusiastic about Agile/XP practices (Pair/Mob programming, TDD, BDD, Continuous Integration, Continuous Delivery) - Willingness to learn new technologies and move between different tech stacks - BSc or MSc in Computer Science or related field (or equivalent experience) Nice to haves: - Experience with real-time credit and fraud or related areas - DevOps and Continuous Delivery Experience - Familiarity with cloud based and DevOps technologies and tools (AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, ECS) Klarna's mission is to take the friction out of how people buy online and we enable our users to purchase online using two bits of top of mind information - your email and postcode. When a user buys with Klarna we determine in real-time if the buyer really is who they appear to be, and if we are prepared to underwrite credit for this transaction and take on the risk. In summary our secret sauce is the ability to issue credit in real-time using behavioural data. With 60M customers, 70k merchants and an annual purchase volume growth in excess of 50% this is a fintech business the deals with growth, scale and all the challenges that come with our ambition to grow the company by 5x in the next three years.

förväntningar som ställs på mitt jobb.Vi hanterar dagligen data från drygt en miljon kundanläggningar och ett elnät som genererar tiotals miljoner mätvärden dagligen.Det är min uppgift att hantera all denna data och tillsammans med vår dataanalysgrupp skapa affärsnytta.Utmaningen är att hantera den stora mängden data, tillgängliggöra den för verksamheten och möjliggöra nya affärer.Det är utmanande en viktig del i transformeringen av E.ON och med dina innovativa ideer driva förändringsarbetet framåt?Då välkomnar vi dig in i vårt kompetenta team där har en lättsam atmosfär och bra förening av kompetenser.Du ges möjligheten att arbeta med alla delar från kravspecifikation till implementerings- och förvaltningsfasen och samtidigt ha roligt på jobbet!Välkommen med din ansökan redan idag då urval kan ske löpande, men senast den 8 november 2017.

Global Services and Operations is responsible for Telia Company's global commercial excellence and technology leadership. Our 1 600 employees' job is to create new businesses and explore potential revenue streams and long-term investment opportunities for the whole company and for all our customers. We are responsible for our global product portfolio, global business, customer experience and our brand architecture. We all work closely with our country markets to make sure that our services, networks and architecture are future proof, secure and add value to customers across all markets. This is how we enable Telia Company becoming a winning New Generation Telco. Are you up for it? We are Telia Company Data & Analytics. We are leading Telia Company's journey of becoming truly data driven, and leveraging big data as part of our ambitions of being a New Generation Telco. We are already 20 highly driven, competent and curios colleagues securing our big data services and outcomes from data and analytics. We are now taking the next step in our execution and are establishing a new team with engineers and developers for developing data pipelines on our data lake. The Data & Analytics organisation at Telia Company provides three core big data 'as a services' to our lines of businesses across six countries. The foundation is Platform as a Service , where we ensure modern data management and analytics tools and platforms. The Data as a Service provides the data pipelining and ensures that refined data is available for analytics to our lines of business. The third service is Analytics as a Service , where we have a team of data scientists working closely with our lines of businesses to ensure insights and outcome from our vast data. A fourth service that we provide is the Value Realization Office , where we work closely with our internal customers to ensure that we monetize and secure value from our data and analytics. At the core of our Platform Services is our Hadoop Data Lake, together with several other modern development, data preparation and analytics tools, ranging from Cloudera, Notebooks, Spark, Kafka, Talend, Qlik, Knime, Zoomdata and SAS. We are working fully with DevOps and agile methodologies, in short sprint cycles, and with continuous releases. We are now seeking a Data Engineer to join the Data Services unit . As a Data Engineer you will be an instrumental part of a unique and inspiring journey as we continue to build our Big Data solution at Telia Company. You will be responsible for securing high-performing, flexible and robust data pipeline solutions using the latest big data technologies to fulfill business needs for analytics purposes. You will work closely with our data analysts/scientists, ELT developers and other technical experts to address this challenge, and through thought leadership act as a hub towards countries in identifying initiatives and supporting problem solving of current data and analytics barriers. We want you to dare. We want you to lead with tenacity, humility, and inspiration and we want you to connect to the hearts and minds of our customers. If you're up for it. If you want to be part of our journey. Then we want to talk to you. The challenge Design, develop and evolve big data solutions that are optimized for analytics, visualization and reporting. Optimize our data pipelines in terms of flexibility, performance and robustness. Work closely with data scientists to develop and optimize algorithms and analytical workflows Take ownership of design standards and best practices, including our shared repository of reusable data pipeline components and templates Proactively improve our solutions to address improvement potentials, fulfill changed business needs and adopt new technology Educate and coach junior data engineers colleagues Develop thought leadership in data engineering Provide continuous support to our development teams. Contribute to Telia Company's long-term architecture and roadmap within big data and analytics. Your experience 5+ years' experience from software and/or data engineering positions within BI and/or analytics. Hands-on experience from developing production-grade data pipelines and analytics workloads using some of the latest Big Data technologies such as MapReduce, Spark, Kafka, Python, R and No-SQL databases. Hands-on experience from development through Continuous Integration and understanding of CI tools such as Jenkins. Very good understanding of key success factors to secure high-performing, flexible and robust big data solutions. Experience from working in ab agile IT environment with high-volume transactional systems. You are able to take responsibility for end-to-end tasks and have a strong analytical and goal-oriented approach to problem solving. You are driven, proactive and enjoy working in a high pace. Delivering true value to our customers and having fun along the way is very important for you. How? Telia Company's values Dare, Care and Simplify are the foundation for everything we do. We Dare to lead by engaging with our customers and challenging ourselves. We Care for our customers by providing solutions that are adapted to their needs. We Simplify our teamwork through transparent communication, active collaboration and knowledge sharing. Since 2005, the company has expanded its operations into more than 20 countries across Europe, North America and the APAC region. Ferratum Group's headquarter is in Helsinki, Finland and the company is listed in the Prime Standard segment of the Frankfurt Stock Exchange. WITH OUR EU BANKING LICENSE AND OUR ESTABLISHED BIG DATA TECHNOLOGY, we are poised to establish ourselves as a leading mobile bank at the cutting edge of the digital revolution in the banking sector. Our aim is to be at the forefront of the mobile revolution in banking. Our main focus is on simple mobile solutions that satisfy every expectation of our customer. With Ferratum Group, your smartphone becomes a mobile bank.ArbetsuppgifterFerratum is now looking for highly motivated and skilled Data Engineer to join our team in Stockholm, Sweden. If you are interested in working in the international financial corporation, bear high performance and good quality of work then you are the one we are looking for! As a Data Engineer you would be a part of data-centric activities at enterprise level in the Company. You will be providing support to various members of the Data team with database design, data flow and analysis activities. You will play a key role in the development and deployment of innovative big data platforms for advanced analytics and data processing. You will be taking part in data management activities such as analysing complex data elements and systems, data flow, dependencies, and relationships to ensure that they comply with data governance program. You will report directly to the Chief Data Officer. Responsibilities: - Perform thorough testing and validation the accuracy of data transformations and data verification used in predictive models. - Ensure proper data governance and quality across the Data department and the business as a whole. - Perform ad-hoc analyses of data stored in the business's MySQL/MS SQL databases and writes SQL scripts, stored procedures, functions, and views. - Ensure controls are in place over applications to ensure the data integrity by performing data integrity gap analysis. - Provide support to the entire department for its data-centric needs. - Advise management on new and improved data engineering strategies that will drive departmental performance. - Lead the overall improvement in data governance and management across the business, promoting informed decision-making, and ultimately improving overall business performance.KvalifikationerBSC/MSc in Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Engineering, or any other technology related field. Fluent English, both oral and written. Experience with data quality or similar level data analysis. Strong understanding of databases and data structures. Strong analytical and time management skills. Self-motivated and able to handle tasks with minimal supervision or questions. Ability to design, build, and maintain the business's ETL pipeline. Ability to compare technologies and make recommendations to senior members of the team. Expertise in data modelling and query performance tuning. Experience with Microsoft SQL Server technology stack is an advantage. Experience with financial services is an advantage.

Location: Linköping      Starting Date: By agreement      Last Application Date: 2019-01-06      What we offer?Our purpose is to create trust in mobility.We design and build state-of-the-art hardware, software, and solutions for active safety, ADAS, autonomous driving, restraint control and brake control      Founded in 2018, Veoneer is building on a heritage of more than 60 years of automotive safety development.Headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden, Veoneer has 7,600 associates in 13 countries (joint ventures included) and is listed on the New York Stock Exchange and on Nasdaq Stockholm      AdditionallyVeoneer inSweden is located in 5 different cities throughout the country, from Skellefteå in the north to Gothenburgon the west coast.Ourcamera systems are developed in Linköping with the help from our highly integrated satellite offices.As a site, our responsibilities range from electronics and optics to software, algorithms and vehicle testing.All vision development teams are working cross-functionally based on agile principles      Do you like to work in an innovative organization with a strong drive for improvements and good career opportunities?Then you will excel at Veoneer!      What you'll do?In the role you will be working in a scrum based cross-functional team responsible for ensuring that Veoneer utilise our vast quantities of data in the most efficient and value-adding way possible.Our team manages vision data (camera, radar, lidar) collected by Veoneer vehicles from around the world.This data is the foundation for our feature algorithms (machine learning) and are in various other ways used to add value to our products.Data is one of our most valuable resources and you will be a central part of ensuring we take good care of it.
